mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kpi_master (id, name, type_code, calculation_rule_code, unit_code, is_global, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{typeCode}, #{calculationRuleCode}, #{unitCode}, #{isGlobal}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kpi_master WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (is_global = true OR created_by = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE kpi_master SET name = #{name}, category_id = #{categoryId}, type_code = #{typeCode}, calculation_rule_code = #{calculationRuleCode}, calculation_type_code = #{calculationTypeCode}, unit_code = #{unitCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{masterKpiId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
